system.description: A Man Trap is a reversed repulsor field that draws a target directly down, as though in incredibly high gravity. A Man Trap covers 1 square, and any creature entering the square of a Man Trap is immediately Immobilized (unable to move voluntarily). A creature can attempt to break out of a Man Trap as a Move Action, requiring a DC 40 Strength check. It can be deactivated using a remote (treat as a Portable Computer with an Intelligence score of 16).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
